exposure: Placental thickness (PT) measured at 32 and 36 weeks of gestation
cohort: 400 pregnant women referred for antenatal scans in India, observed from February 2023-2024.
finding: Placental thickness at 32 and 36 weeks correlates significantly with fetal birth weight, with a stronger correlation observed at 36 weeks (r = 0.432) compared to 32 weeks (r = 0.316).
cross-section timing: Placental thickness measurements were taken at 32 and 36 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: 32 and 36 weeks of gestation (for placental thickness measurements)
